description:
Manage Focus time-blocks with the following actions:

- **archive**: Archive Time Blocks. (data: task_id*, time_block_id*)
- **bulk-create**: Bulk Create Time Blocks. (data: payload*{time_blocks*})
- **bulk-delete**: Bulk Delete Time Blocks. (data: ids*, outbound_sync)
- **bulk-partial-update**: Bulk Partial Update Time Blocks. (data: payload*)
- **create**: Create Time Blocks. (data: payload*{start*, completed, duration, outbound_sync}, task_id*)
- **delete**: Delete Time Blocks. (data: outbound_sync, task_id*, time_block_id*)
- **get**: Get Time Blocks. (data: task_id*, time_block_id*)
- **get-range**: Get Range Time Blocks. (data: archived*, date_from*, date_to*, order_by*, page*, per_page*, status_id*, task_id*)
- **get-range-stream**: Get Range Stream Time Blocks. (data: archived*, date_from*, date_to*, order_by*, status_id*, task_id*)
- **get-task-time-blocks**: Get Task Time Blocks Time Blocks. (data: archived, order_by, page, per_page, task_id*)
- **partial-update**: Partial Update Time Blocks. (data: payload*{completed, duration, outbound_sync, start, task_id}, task_id*, time_block_id*)
- **restore**: Restore Time Blocks. (data: task_id*, time_block_id*)
- **unarchive**: Unarchive Time Blocks. (data: task_id*, time_block_id*)
- **update**: Update Time Blocks. (data: payload*{start*, completed, duration, outbound_sync}, task_id*, time_block_id*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: archive, bulk-create, bulk-delete, bulk-partial-update, create, delete, get, get-range, get-range-stream, get-task-time-blocks, partial-update, restore, unarchive, update

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
